mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_message_log (message_id,message_type,publish_purpose,business_key,user_id,coupon_id,payload, payload_schema_version,exchange_name,routing_key,status,dead_letter_status,confirm_status, returned,publish_attempt,consume_attempt,fallback_attempt,version,last_error,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{messageId},#{messageType},#{publishPurpose},#{businessKey},#{userId},#{couponId},#{payload}, #{payloadSchemaVersion},#{exchangeName},#{routingKey},#{status},#{deadLetterStatus},#{confirmStatus}, #{returned},#{publishAttempt},#{consumeAttempt},0,#{version},#{lastError},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT message_log.*, message_id AS messageId,message_type AS messageType,publish_purpose AS publishPurpose, business_key AS businessKey,user_id AS userId,coupon_id AS couponId, current_correlation_id AS currentCorrelationId,publish_attempt AS publishAttempt, consume_attempt AS consumeAttempt,dead_letter_status AS deadLetterStatus, confirm_status AS confirmStatus,due_at AS dueAt,next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, source_message_id AS sourceMessageId FROM seckill_message_log message_log WHERE message_id=#{messageId}
SELECT * FROM seckill_message_log WHERE message_id=#{messageId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_message_log SET publish_attempt=publish_attempt+1, current_correlation_id=CONCAT(message_id, ':P', publish_attempt+1), publish_purpose=#{publishPurpose}, status='SENT', confirm_status='PENDING', returned=0, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND status IN ('PREPARED','RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING','TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING', 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING') AND publish_attempt<5 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN 'COMPENSATION_PENDING' WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING' WHEN message_type IN ('BUSINESS_DEAD_LETTER','INVALID_MESSAGE') THEN 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING' ELSE 'RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING' END, confirm_status='NACK', last_error=#{lastError}, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 5 SECOND) END, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND current_correlation_id=#{correlationId} AND status NOT IN ('PROCESSING','CONSUMED','CONSUME_EXHAUSTED','COMPENSATION_PENDING', 'COMPENSATED','MANUAL_REQUIRED') AND status='SENT'

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET returned=1, return_reply_code=#{replyCode}, return_reply_text=LEFT(#{replyText},255), confirm_status='PENDING', last_error=CONCAT('return ',#{exchange},'/',#{routingKey}), version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND current_correlation_id=#{correlationId} AND returned=0 AND confirm_status IN ('PENDING','ACK') AND status IN ('SENT','BROKER_ACKED')

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status=CASE #{action} WHEN 'MARK_ACKED' THEN CASE WHEN returned=1 THEN status ELSE 'BROKER_ACKED' END WHEN 'COMPENSATE_RESERVATION' THEN 'COMPENSATION_PENDING' WHEN 'RETRY_ORDER' THEN 'RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING' WHEN 'RETRY_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING' WHEN 'RETRY_DEAD_LETTER' THEN 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING' ELSE status END, confirm_status=CASE WHEN #{action}='MARK_ACKED' AND returned=0 THEN 'ACK' ELSE 'NACK' END, confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{action}='MARK_ACKED' AND returned=0 THEN NOW(3) ELSE confirmed_at END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{action} IN ('RETRY_ORDER','RETRY_TIMEOUT','RETRY_DEAD_LETTER') THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 5 SECOND) ELSE next_retry_at END, last_error=COALESCE(#{lastError},last_error), version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND current_correlation_id=#{correlationId} AND ((#{action}='MARK_ACKED' AND status='SENT' AND confirm_status='PENDING' AND returned=0) OR (#{action}<>'MARK_ACKED' AND status IN ('SENT','BROKER_ACKED') AND confirm_status='PENDING'))

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET last_error=RIGHT(CONCAT_WS(' | ',NULLIF(last_error,''), LEFT(CONCAT('stale ',#{correlationId},' ',COALESCE(#{summary},'')),240)),500), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId}

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='PROCESSING',consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt},processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}, locked_by=#{worker},locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND), version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND business_key=#{businessKey} AND user_id=#{userId} AND coupon_id=#{couponId} AND consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}-1 AND status IN ('SENT','BROKER_ACKED','RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING')

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='CONSUMED',consumed_at=COALESCE(consumed_at,NOW(3)), processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND status='PROCESSING' AND consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND locked_by=#{worker}

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='PROCESSING',consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt},processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}, locked_by=#{worker},locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND), version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND business_key=#{businessKey} AND payload=#{payload} AND ((consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}-1 AND status IN ('SENT','BROKER_ACKED','TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING')) OR (consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until<NOW(3)))

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='CONSUMED',consumed_at=COALESCE(consumed_at,NOW(3)), processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='PROCESSING' AND consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND locked_by=#{worker}

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='CONSUMED', publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK', consumed_at=COALESCE(consumed_at,NOW(3)), last_error=NULL, processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status NOT IN ('CONSUMED','COMPENSATED')

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK', status=CASE WHEN fallback_attempt>=#{maxAttempts}-1 THEN 'MANUAL_REQUIRED' ELSE 'TIMEOUT_FALLBACK_PENDING' END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN fallback_attempt>=#{maxAttempts}-1 THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL LEAST(300,POW(2,fallback_attempt)) SECOND) END, fallback_attempt=LEAST(#{maxAttempts},fallback_attempt+1), processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, last_error=LEFT(#{lastError},500),version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status IN ('PREPARED','BROKER_ACKED','TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING','TIMEOUT_FALLBACK_PENDING', 'CONSUME_EXHAUSTED')

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='COMPENSATED',version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=CONCAT('SECKILL_ORDER_CREATE:',#{orderNumber}) AND message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' AND status='COMPENSATION_PENDING'

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}, publish_purpose=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_RECOVERY' ELSE 'CONSUME_RETRY' END, status=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}>=3 THEN 'CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING' ELSE 'RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING' END, dead_letter_status=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}>=3 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE dead_letter_status END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}<3 THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL POW(2,#{incomingAttempt}-1) SECOND) ELSE NULL END, last_error=#{lastError}, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) ,processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type IN ('ORDER_CREATE','ORDER_TIMEOUT') AND ((consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt}-1 AND status<>'PROCESSING') OR (consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND status='PROCESSING' AND processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt})) AND status NOT IN ('CONSUMED','COMPENSATED','MANUAL_REQUIRED','CONSUME_EXHAUSTED')

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_RECOVERY', status=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}>=3 THEN 'CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' ELSE 'TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING' END, dead_letter_status=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}>=3 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE dead_letter_status END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{incomingAttempt}<3 THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL POW(2,#{incomingAttempt}-1) SECOND) ELSE NULL END, last_error=#{lastError},version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3), processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='PROCESSING' AND consume_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND processing_attempt=#{incomingAttempt} AND locked_by=#{claimToken}

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='MANUAL_REQUIRED', last_error=CONCAT('consume attempt gap: ',#{incomingAttempt},' ',#{lastError}), processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND status NOT IN ('CONSUMED','COMPENSATED','CONSUME_EXHAUSTED') AND consume_attempt<#{incomingAttempt}-1

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET dead_letter_status=#{deadLetterStatus}, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND (status='CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' OR (message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='CONSUMED' AND publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK'))

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN 'COMPENSATION_PENDING' WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING' WHEN message_type IN ('BUSINESS_DEAD_LETTER','INVALID_MESSAGE') THEN 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING' ELSE 'RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING' END, publish_purpose=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN 'INITIAL' WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_RECOVERY' WHEN message_type IN ('BUSINESS_DEAD_LETTER','INVALID_MESSAGE') THEN 'DEAD_LETTER' ELSE 'CONSUME_RETRY' END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN NULL ELSE NOW(3) END, last_error=CASE WHEN returned=1 THEN 'mandatory return recovery' ELSE 'publisher confirm timeout' END, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE status='SENT' AND confirm_status='PENDING' AND updated_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status='TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING',publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_RECOVERY', next_retry_at=NOW(3),processing_attempt=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, last_error='timeout consume lease expired',version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until<NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose='INITIAL' THEN 'COMPENSATION_PENDING' WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' THEN 'CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_FALLBACK_PENDING' ELSE 'MANUAL_REQUIRED' END, publish_purpose=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN 'TIMEOUT_FALLBACK' ELSE publish_purpose END, dead_letter_status=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND publish_purpose<>'INITIAL' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE dead_letter_status END, confirm_status=CASE WHEN confirm_status='PENDING' THEN 'TIMEOUT' ELSE confirm_status END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(next_retry_at,due_at),due_at) ELSE NULL END, last_error='publish attempts exhausted', version=version+1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE publish_attempt>=#{maxAttempts} AND status IN ('PREPARED','RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING','TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING', 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

UPDATE seckill_message_log source INNER JOIN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT candidate.id FROM seckill_message_log candidate INNER JOIN seckill_message_log dead ON dead.source_message_id=candidate.message_id AND dead.message_type='BUSINESS_DEAD_LETTER' AND dead.status='MANUAL_REQUIRED' WHERE (candidate.status='CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' OR (candidate.message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND candidate.status='CONSUMED' AND candidate.publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK')) AND candidate.dead_letter_status<>'MANUAL_REQUIRED' ORDER BY candidate.id LIMIT 100 ) bounded_source_ids ) target ON target.id=source.id INNER JOIN seckill_message_log dead_letter ON dead_letter.source_message_id=source.message_id AND dead_letter.message_type='BUSINESS_DEAD_LETTER' AND dead_letter.status='MANUAL_REQUIRED' SET source.dead_letter_status='MANUAL_REQUIRED', source.version=source.version+1, source.updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE (source.status='CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' OR (source.message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND source.status='CONSUMED' AND source.publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK')) AND source.dead_letter_status<>'MANUAL_REQUIRED'

UPDATE seckill_message_log SET status=CASE WHEN publish_attempt>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'MANUAL_REQUIRED' ELSE 'RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING' END, publish_purpose='CONSUME_RETRY', next_retry_at=CASE WHEN publish_attempt>=#{maxAttempts} THEN NULL ELSE NOW(3) END, last_error=CASE WHEN publish_attempt>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'reconciliation delivery attempts exhausted' ELSE 'reconciliation detected stale broker ack' END, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND status IN ('BROKER_ACKED','SENT')
mapper.select: SELECT message_log.* FROM seckill_message_log message_log LEFT JOIN seckill_compensation_record compensation ON compensation.compensation_action='RELEASE_RESERVATION' AND compensation.order_number=message_log.business_key WHERE message_log.message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND message_log.publish_purpose='INITIAL' AND message_log.status='COMPENSATION_PENDING' AND compensation.id IS NULL ORDER BY message_log.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT source.*, source.message_id AS messageId,source.message_type AS messageType, source.business_key AS businessKey,source.user_id AS userId,source.coupon_id AS couponId, source.consume_attempt AS consumeAttempt FROM seckill_message_log source LEFT JOIN seckill_message_log dead_letter ON dead_letter.message_id=CONCAT('SECKILL_DEAD:',source.message_id) WHERE source.message_type='ORDER_CREATE' AND source.status='CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' AND source.dead_letter_status='PENDING' AND dead_letter.id IS NULL ORDER BY source.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM seckill_message_log WHERE (status IN ('PREPARED','RETRY_PUBLISH_PENDING','TIMEOUT_PUBLISH_PENDING', 'DEAD_LETTER_PUBLISH_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))) OR (message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='BROKER_ACKED' AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at<=NOW(3)) OR (message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='CONSUME_EXHAUSTED' AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at<=NOW(3)) OR (message_type='ORDER_TIMEOUT' AND status='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK_PENDING' AND publish_purpose='TIMEOUT_FALLBACK' AND fallback_attempt<3 AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at<=NOW(3) AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at,created_at),id LIMIT #{limit}
